translations.web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
translations.bsb: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
translations.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
translations.asv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured unto you.
